method: Replace v9 quality-only broadcast phase classifier with an 18-feature availability-aware binary logistic head. Train all 301 native public rows; preserve missing geometry as NaN, add observable availability, and predict over the existing primary-video coverage. Other five classifiers, phase weight, margins and temporal operations stay unchanged.

phase_head.coverage: primary video, including missing broadcast geometry

inputs.algorithm: naive +/-2 frame residual and Farneback flow, existing Extractor
FILM +/-2 frame residual and Farneback flow

limitations: All selection reuses the same 17 public possessions; partitions are sensitivity checks, not independent tests.
Five-fold macro gain is 0.000846 with 12 corrected and 7 regressed public frames, a net gain of five.
Dead recall increases while dead precision and away F1 decrease.
Missingness patterns can depend on the recording; unseen-match transfer is unknown.
The same three GT possessions remain missed.
Private or full-match accuracy is unknown; match statistics describe predictions.
Restricted geometry, audio/video, per-frame features and prediction labels stay gitignored.
